annotations.title: Solana Swap Transaction: Unsigned Swap for Your Wallet

description: Build an unsigned Solana swap transaction through a DEX aggregator for a wallet you control. The response contains the base64 transaction, the quote and every fee in basis points, including any integrator fee. Non-custodial: you sign locally, we never see keys or funds and do not send transactions. Not investment advice. Builds or quotes only: nothing is signed or sent by this tool. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).

amount.description: Amount of the input token in its smallest unit.

inputMint.description: Mint address of the token to sell.

outputMint.description: Mint address of the token to buy.

slippageBps.description: Maximum slippage in basis points. Omit for the automatic estimate.

taker.description: Your wallet address (public key) that will sign and pay.
